caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded, brown ceramic jar with a wide mouth and two looped handles positioned symmetrically near the upper sides. The body of the jar is predominantly tan with subtle gradients and faint mottling, giving it a glazed appearance with hints of yellow and darker brown. On the upper front surface of the jar, there is an inscription in small, dark letters reading "JAS. HART OSWEGO FALLS." Below the inscription and slightly to the right, there is a blue decorative floral motif painted on the jar, consisting of curved petals and stylized leaves. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present. The artist’s signature, "J. Tarsanino," appears unobtrusively in small letters at the lower right corner of the page.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
